item.title: ACP Rejects HSE Plans For €25M Hospital At St Flannan’s College
item.description: An Comisiún Pleanála (ACP) has refused planning permission to contentious plans for a €25m HSE community hospital for Catholic Church-owned green space at St Flannan’s College in Ennis. item.title: Met Éireann Issues Rainfall Alert For Clare
item.description: A low level yellow rainfall alert has been issued for Clare. Met Éireann is forecasting spells of heavy rain on already saturated ground on Saturday evening. Likely impacts include river and surface water flooding, difficult travelling conditions and poor visibility. The alert comes into force at 6 o’clock on Saturday evening and remains in place […] The post Met Éireann Issues Rainfall Alert For Clare appeared first on Clare FM.
